chunks: And 'Ubaydullāh ibn al-Faďl ibn Muḥammad ibn Hilāl narrated to me, saying: 'Abd al-Raḥmān narrated to us, saying: Sa'īd ibn Khaytham narrated to us from his brother Ma'mar, saying: I heard Zayd ibn 'Ali say:

Whoever visits the grave of al-Ḥusayn ibn 'Ali (peace be upon him), seeking nothing by it except the Face of Allāh, the Exalted, all of his sins will be forgiven, even if they are like the foam of the sea. So increase in visiting him, that Allāh may forgive your sins.

key_terms.وَجْهَ اللَّهِ: The Face of God (seeking His pleasure)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for visiting the grave of Imam Husayn (a.s.)?
ai.summary: In this narration from Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, Zayd ibn 'Ali highlights the immense spiritual merit of visiting Imam al-Husayn’s shrine with pure intention (ikhlas), promising the forgiveness of all sins, even if they are as numerous as the foam of the sea. This tradition underscores the Shia belief in the intercessory and purifying power of the Ahl al-Bayt’s graves, encouraging believers to frequently engage in ziyārah as a means of drawing closer to God and attaining divine mercy.
